description: License policy for every package in the dependency tree of the API test client. Checked by scripts/check-npm-licenses.mjs as part of `just deny`. Nothing of this tree is shipped: it is what CI validates the public API's OpenAPI document and generates its TypeScript client with.

notes.Python-2.0: Permissive (PSF license, OSI approved). argparse, reached from openapi-typescript through @redocly/openapi-core and js-yaml. A build-time tool of the test client only; in no image.
